title: Cyberpunk RED - Evasion Workflow
description: Interactive Evasion/Dodge workflow for Cyberpunk RED, community fork of Vec97/cpred-evasion-workflow. Ranged targets choose Evade or Tank before hit/miss is revealed. Melee defense can resolve automatically or offer a manual Evade/Tank choice; melee Tank accepts the hit without an Evasion roll. Optional weapon damage uses the system's GM-routed damage pipeline. Defense choices are persisted to protect against repeated damage from old chat cards. Coexists with diwako-cpred-additions without modifying it.
